title: Aerospike Operator & Kubernetes View
description: Visualizes controller-runtime and work-queue metrics for the Aerospike Kubernetes Operator (AKO) running on Aerospike Cloud. Provides insights into performance, behavior, and reconciliation efficiency. (OpenMetrics integration).

definition.title: Cluster Phase (by status)
definition.description: Current number of AerospikeCluster resources grouped by phase, such as Completed, InProgress, and Error.

definition.title: Workqueue Depth
definition.description: Current depth of the controller workqueue. High values indicate reconciliation requests are queuing up faster than they can be processed.

definition.title: Pods Running
definition.description: Current running pods in the aerospike namespace (kube_namespace:aerospike). Shows the last reported value.

definition.title: Container Restarts
definition.description: Current cumulative container restart count for the selected Aerospike database. Increasing values may indicate crashes, OOM terminations, or container instability.

definition.content: The **Aerospike Operator & Kubernetes Overview** dashboard visualizes key cluster metrics across AKO, Pods, Webhooks and controller runtime.

definition.title: Leader status
definition.description: Current leader-election status across AKO instances. A value of 1 indicates that exactly one AKO instance is the active leader.

definition.title: Cluster Phase Over Time
definition.description: Tracks Aerospike cluster phase transitions over time (completed, inprogress, error). Metric: aerospike_ako_aerospikecluster_phase (grouped by phase).

definition.title: Leader status by Pod
definition.description: Leader-election status for each AKO pod over time. A value of 1 identifies the active leader; 0 identifies a non-leader instance.

definition.title: Pods Running
definition.description: Current count of running pods across Aerospike deployments. Metric: kubernetes.pods.running (filtered by kube_deployment:aerospike*).

definition.title: Containers Running by Pod
definition.description: Number of currently running containers per Aerospike pod over time. A decrease may indicate a failed or unready container.

definition.title: CPU Utilization % (of Limits)
definition.description: CPU utilization as a percentage of configured limits for Aerospike pods. Metrics: kubernetes.cpu.usage.total / kubernetes.cpu.limits (filtered by kube_deployment:aerospike*). (NOTE: Datadog reports cpu time in nano-seconds)

definition.title: Memory Utilization % (of Limits)
definition.description: Current memory usage as a percentage of configured memory limits for the selected Aerospike database.

definition.title: Pods Running
definition.description: Running pod count over time for Aerospike deployments. Useful for spotting scaling events or disruptions. Metric: kubernetes.pods.running (filtered by kube_deployment:aerospike*).

definition.title: Memory Usage (by Pod)
definition.description: Memory usage as a percentage of the configured memory limit for each Aerospike pod over time.

definition.title: CPU Utilization % (by Pod)
definition.description: CPU usage as a percentage of the configured CPU limit for each Aerospike pod over time.

definition.title: Container Restarts
definition.description: Container restart trend over time for Aerospike deployments. Spikes indicate pod instability. Metric: kubernetes.containers.restarts (filtered by kube_deployment:aerospike*).

definition.title: REST Client Success (rate) by Code
definition.description: Rate of successful REST client requests broken down by 2xx status code.

definition.title: REST Client Failure (rate) by Code
definition.description: Rate of failed REST client requests broken down by non-2xx status code.

definition.title: REST Client Success (rate) by Code (2xx)
definition.description: Successful (2xx) REST client request rate over time, grouped by status code. Metric: rest_client_requests.count (filtered by code:2*, grouped by code).

definition.title: REST Client Failure (rate) by Code (non-2xx)
definition.description: Failed (non-2xx) REST client request rate over time, grouped by status code. High values may indicate API server issues. Metric: rest_client_requests.count (filtered by !code:2*, grouped by code).

definition.title: Success (rate)
definition.description: Total rate of successful webhook requests (2xx).

definition.title: Failure (rate)
definition.description: Total rate of failed webhook requests (non-2xx).

definition.title: Requests In-Flight
definition.description: Current number of webhook requests being processed.

definition.title: Requests Success (rate) (2xx)
definition.description: Successful (2xx) webhook request rate over time. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_requests_total (filtered by code:2*).

definition.title: Requests Failure (rate) (non-2xx)
definition.description: Failed (non-2xx) webhook request rate over time. Non-zero values indicate admission or validation issues. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_requests_total(filtered by !code:2*).

definition.title: Requests In-Flight (over time)
definition.description: Concurrent webhook requests over time. Sustained high values may indicate webhook processing delays. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_requests_in_flight.

definition.title: Depth
definition.description: Number of pending items in the workqueue over time. Increasing depth indicates the controller cannot keep up with incoming work. Metric: workqueue_depth.

definition.title: Retries (rate)
definition.description: Rate of item retries in the workqueue. High retry rates indicate repeated reconciliation failures. Metric: workqueue_retries_total

definition.title: Longest Running Processor (seconds)
definition.description: Duration of the longest-running processor in the workqueue. High values suggest a stuck or slow reconciliation. Metric: workqueue_longest_running_processor_seconds.

definition.title: Unfinished Work (seconds)
definition.description: Total processing time accumulated by currently unfinished workqueue items. Sustained or increasing values may indicate slow or stuck reconciliation workers.

definition.title: Adds (rate)
definition.description: Rate of new items being added to the workqueue. Correlates with cluster events triggering reconciliation. Metric: workqueue_adds.count.

definition.title: Queue Duration (avg) (seconds)
definition.description: Average time workqueue items spend waiting before being requested for processing. Sustained increases indicate workqueue backlog.

definition.title: Active Workers
definition.description: Number of active reconciliation workers currently processing items. Compare with Max Concurrent Reconciles for capacity utilization. Metric: controller_runtime_active_workers.

definition.title: Reconcile (rate)
definition.description: Rate of reconciliation loops executed by the controller. Metric: controller_runtime_reconcile_total

definition.title: Reconcile Errors (rate)
definition.description: Rate of failed reconciliation attempts. Non-zero values indicate the operator is encountering errors during reconciliation. Metric: controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total

definition.title: Reconcile Time (seconds)
definition.description: Distribution of time taken per reconciliation loop. Helps identify slow reconciliations. Metric: controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds

definition.title: Terminal Reconcile Errors (rate)
definition.description: Rate of terminal (non-retryable) reconciliation errors. These indicate permanent failures requiring manual intervention. Metric: controller_runtime_terminal_reconcile_errors_total

definition.title: Max Concurrent Reconciles
definition.description: Maximum number of concurrent reconciliations allowed by configuration. Compare with Active Workers to assess capacity utilization. Metric: controller_runtime_max_concurrent_reconciles.

definition.title: Webhook Requests (rate)
definition.description: Overall rate of webhook requests handled by the controller runtime. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_requests_total.

definition.title: Webhook Latency (seconds)
definition.description: Distribution of webhook request processing latency. High latency may impact admission response times. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_latency_seconds.

definition.title: Webhook Requests In-Flight
definition.description: Number of webhook requests currently in-flight over time. High concurrency may indicate webhook saturation. Metric: controller_runtime_webhook_requests_in_flight.
